summary: Cebu City 2nd District representative with 28 principal-authored bills. Authored abolition of the estate tax, travel-tax abolition, patient rights against hospital detention, front-of-package food warnings, removal of system losses from electricity bills and a constitutional right to access information. Co-authored the national minimum wage, a P200 daily wage increase, a VAT cut to 10 percent, a plastic excise and a tax amnesty.
caveat: Right to information is a single institutions issue and unscored. Tax bills pull right and labor bills pull left.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored estate tax abolition and travel tax abolition (+2, taxes) against patient rights over hospital detention (-2), food warning labels and removal of electricity system losses (-1 to -2); co-authored the national minimum wage and wage increases (-2 to -3).
